methodology_note: Real coach-per-edition data researched for the 2010 FIFA World Cup (South Africa) specifically, extending the Argumental coach-cycle solar-revolution signal backtest to a third real past edition -- the oldest one this project has researched. Keyed by team name exactly as it appears in engine.backtest's parsed historical matches (post-alias). Each entry is the coach who actually led the team AT the 2010 tournament and the date/time/venue of THEIR first match in charge of that continuous tenure. 10 of the 32 real 2010 participants are deliberately omitted because a genuine kickoff time could not be sourced despite the date/opponent/score/venue being well confirmed by RSSSF and other independent sources -- this project's no-placeholder-time policy applies as strictly to 2010 as to every other edition.
